learning_outcomes.text: explain the structure and function of internal combustion engines
represent the forces in the power-transmitting components
calculate free forces and moments and their compensation
demonstrate the working process of a perfect engine
define the air-fuel ratio and explain its significance
name and compare methods of exhaust gas aftertreatment
demonstrate and illustrate the operation of supercharging / turbochargers

syllabus_topics: General terms, cylinder arrangement, crank mechanism, piston speed, piston acceleration, volumetric flow, dead space, forces, inertial forces, mass balancing, cyclic processes

assessment_methods.method: Written exam (90 min) or other examination form

assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module exam and successful participation in the laboratory session. The examination form will be announced at the beginning of the course. The grade weighting is based on credit points.
bibliography: Eifler et al.: Küttner: Kolbenmaschinen, Vieweg + Teubner, 7. Auflage
Grohe, H.: Otto- und Dieselmotoren, Vogel-Verlag
